CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH ayden AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ed.mit_id
    FROM employee_directory ed
    WHERE upper(ed.first_name) = 'AYDEN' AND upper(ed.last_name) = 'HOPKINS'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT dd.mit_id
    FROM drupal_employee_directory dd
    WHERE upper(dd.first_name) = 'AYDEN' AND upper(dd.last_name) = 'HOPKINS'
),
member_rows AS (
    SELECT mld.moira_list_key, mld.moira_list_member_mit_id::BIGINT AS mit_id
    FROM list_members mld
    WHERE mld.moira_list_member_mit_id IS NOT NULL
),
ayden_lists AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mr.moira_list_key
    FROM member_rows mr
    JOIN ayden a ON a.mit_id = mr.mit_id
),
lists_r AS (
    SELECT l.moira_list_key, l.moira_list_name, l.moira_list_description
    FROM lists l
    WHERE l.moira_list_name ILIKE 'r%'
),
owners AS (
    SELECT ld.moira_list_key, lo.owner, lo.owner_type
    FROM list_detail ld
    LEFT JOIN list_owners lo ON lo.moira_list_owner_key = ld.moira_list_owner_key
),
list_members_clean AS (
    SELECT lm.moira_list_key,
           lm.moira_list_member_full_name,
           CASE WHEN lm.moira_list_member_mit_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE lm.moira_list_member_mit_id::BIGINT END AS mit_id
    FROM list_members lm
),
faculty_flags AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fr.mit_id,
           CASE WHEN fr.job_title ILIKE '%Professor%' AND (fr.emeritus_status IS NULL OR fr.emeritus_status ILIKE 'N%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_tenured_proxy
    FROM hr_faculty_roster fr
),
member_with_faculty AS (
    SELECT lmc.moira_list_key,
           lmc.mit_id,
           COALESCE(ff.is_tenured_proxy, 0) AS is_tenured_proxy
    FROM list_members_clean lmc
    LEFT JOIN faculty_flags ff ON ff.mit_id = lmc.mit_id
),
counts AS (
    SELECT mwf.moira_list_key,
           COUNT(*) AS member_count,
           SUM(mwf.is_tenured_proxy) AS tenured_faculty_count
    FROM member_with_faculty mwf
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT lr.moira_list_name AS list_name,
       lr.moira_list_description AS list_description,
       ow.owner,
       COALESCE(ct.member_count, 0) AS number_of_people,
       COALESCE(ct.tenured_faculty_count, 0) AS number_of_tenured_faculty
FROM ayden_lists al
JOIN lists_r lr ON lr.moira_list_key = al.moira_list_key
LEFT JOIN owners ow ON ow.moira_list_key = lr.moira_list_key
LEFT JOIN counts ct ON ct.moira_list_key = lr.moira_list_key
ORDER BY list_name
